standard.name: AMS2630
standard.title: Inspection, Ultrasonic - Product Over 0.5 Inch (12.7 mm) Thick

qualification.facility: Subject to purchaser survey and approval; equipment, references, couplants, fixtures, and tanks are available on request.

frequency.selectionRule: Use the highest practical frequency that provides required penetration and resolution.

beamProfile.focalLengthVerification: Annual verification when focal length is used to set water path without setup verification.
beamProfile.roundTransducerBeamWidthRatioMin: 0.75:1 at -6 dB points in two directions 90 deg apart

couplant.immersion: Tap water permitted; other fluids specified by procedure. Fluid must be free of visible air bubbles and excessive attenuation.
couplant.contact: Must not injure the product and must be approved in procedure.

procedureMinimumContent: Specific product or part number, fabrication stage, surface condition, and configuration
Instrumentation, recording equipment, fixtures, tanks, manipulators, and coupling means
Testing plan, recording procedure, scanning plan, sensitivity, interpretation method, and relationship to references

systemStandardization.standardizationCheck: Before each part configuration or shift and at completion of each lot or shift
systemStandardization.undersensitiveAction: Reinspect material since last standardization if response is more than 10 percent undersensitive.
systemStandardization.oversensitiveAction: Rejected indications since last standardization may be re-evaluated if response is more than 10 percent oversensitive.

scanIndex.basis: Smallest effective beam width measured at planned gain, water travel, and alarm level.

scanSpeed.higherSpeedCondition: Permitted when PRR/coverage criteria are defined or dynamic reference check is performed.

scanParameters.manualScanningGain: Add 6 dB to reference gain when manually monitoring internal discontinuity amplitudes, unless noise exceeds alarm level.

C.criteria: Established by purchaser and vendor for specific part
Established by purchaser and vendor for specific part

acceptanceClasses.multipleIndicationSpacing: Multiple discontinuities above the listed reference are unacceptable when centers of any two are less than 1 in / 25 mm apart.
acceptanceClasses.backReflectionLoss: Unsaturated back-reflection loss greater than 50 percent is unacceptable when accompanied by internal signal increase at least twice normal background noise.
acceptanceClasses.notchesOrSDH: Classes for angle beam using notches or SDH are by purchaser/vendor agreement.

systemUse.notes: This extracted class set replaces the previous generic AAA/AA/A/B/C assumption for AMS-2630.
